activity.overview: Listen to a true text. Tell what it is mostly about and one fact.
activity.passage: Frogs are animals that live near water. A frog starts life as a tiny egg. The egg hatches into a tadpole. A tadpole has a tail and swims like a fish. Then it grows legs and loses its tail. Now it is a frog! Frogs use their long, sticky tongues to catch bugs.

questions.prompt: What is this text mostly about?
What does a frog egg hatch into?
How does a frog catch bugs?

activity.subject: english-language-arts
activity.title: Facts About Frogs
